title: Oscillatory replacement
corrections_consumed: law-uniform scalar quadratic-phase decay is false for arbitrary cap-one densities
arbitrary spectral rotation does not preserve product independence
arbitrary-joint rank-three coarea density bound is false
one uniformly good fixed physical minor or rank-three cross cut is not forced by the spectral hypothesis
small matrix operator norm is not a uniformly small random quadratic perturbation

premises.use: volume law and Theorem H; Theorem H is applied to the strict-N3 crossed two-star family
sharp q-fractional three-volume bound with q=43/32
designated partner indefinite-pair plus rank-two-Schur theorem, applied to the same stress family

new_result.name: QFORM-VOLUME-MARGINAL-TO-THREE-HUB-v1
new_result.statement: For a cross block M with Z=e3(M^T M)>0, if the three largest row-volume marginals sum to 2+delta with delta>0, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3 sqrt(2) delta^(-1/6) Z^(-1/6), with arbitrary self blocks and outside couplings. Same for column marginals. With h=43/64, escaping the sharp fractional-volume branch and the three-hub branch on both orientations forces exactly one or two h-heavy volume coordinates on each side.

stress_family.definition: m=k^4; M_k=k e_a u_R^T + k u_L e_b^T + k^(-2)e_c e_d^T; A_k=[[0,M_k],[M_k^T,0]]
stress_family.strict_N3: all physical diagonals zero; every physical pair determinant <=1/k^2
stress_family.three_hub_loss: best Pi3=k^-2, so three-hub certificate grows like k^(2/3)
stress_family.claude_H_payment: hubs {a,b}, diffuse leaves L union R, Gram=diag(k^2,k^2), leverage=1/m, hence ||p||_infinity<=4/k
stress_family.partner_application: pair {a,y1}, Schur pair {b,x1}: D=k^-2, kappa=k^-1, Pi2=k^-2, hence partner bound <=64k

next_step: For a target-scale rank-three cross-volume packet with only one or two 43/64-heavy coordinates on each side, retain arbitrary within-leaf curvature and prove a quantitative route to mixed hubs/rank-two/grouped/pair receivers, or isolate an additional invariant; do not assume a target-scale rank-three cross block exists from the bare spectral hypothesis.
